instruction: On PyPI, open the download files of numpy version 2.1.3. Download the wheel that pip would install for CPython 3.12 on a standard glibc-based 64-bit x86 Linux machine. musllinux, aarch64, macOS and Windows wheels, wheels for other Python versions, and the source distribution do not qualify. A saved file is not required; the outcome is initiation of the correct download.
